description: The Swedish Transport Agency publishes open data consisting of statistics on the transport modes it regulates: rail, aviation, shipping and road. For roads the lists include inspection, vehicle, driving licence and scrapping statistics, accident statistics, number plates, carbon dioxide emissions, congestion tax, commercial traffic and driving and rest times; for shipping, accident statistics, leisure boats, seafarers and incidents; for aviation, flight time and landing statistics, airport statistics, certificates, incidents and accidents, and an aviation traffic forecast; and for rail, reports on accidents and incidents. Coverage is Sweden. Access: free on the agency's website, set out by mode; the licence and file formats are given on the individual pages, not the overview page read. Caveats: these are regulatory statistics, mostly aggregated, not network or asset data. It supports incident and accident analysis, vehicle fleet and demand baselines and aviation capacity planning, and complements Trafikverket's NVDB and open API catalogued here.
